method: Production React in JSDOM: direct adjustment, source navigation, immutable transaction counts, physical recording order, incomplete historic balances, cancellation, decimals and batch isolation. No real-device visual verification.
checks: stock adjustment opens directly with locked current stock and no selection gateway
decreasing physical count creates one correction with the correct delta and source
increasing physical count is a positive correction
zero count remains available through archived correction history
invalid unchanged adjustment leaves data unchanged
invalid blank quantity adjustment leaves data unchanged
invalid negative adjustment leaves data unchanged
invalid precision adjustment leaves data unchanged
invalid missing reason adjustment leaves data unchanged
all sources share signed amounts, source labels, balances and one card per event
purchase movement opens its existing shopping source
usage movement opens its matching activity
correction movement opens its detail without entering Activity
unsaved metadata blocks both adjustment and opening shopping history
manual origin stays a balance anchor without adding a movement
missing origin quantities do not invent historic balances
a mismatch at an old physical correction hides inferred balances even when final totals match
backdated usage is ordered by recording and keeps the physical balance correct
cancellation retains original and reversal cards with a reconciled balance
mixed-unit legacy records show recorded amounts and leave remaining stock unknown
decimal corrections render a rounded delta and correct stock transitions
receipt source stays scoped to the selected inventory card
missing timestamps stay unknown and never show an invented epoch date
legacy correction in a mismatched unit does not relabel its before/after as the current unit
opening stock without movements has only an empty state and no incomplete-history warning
unknown legacy origin is not fabricated and has no placeholder movement
purchase without later changes still has one receipt movement and no duplicate Detail block
purchase movement without recording time uses available date and never epoch
new demo stock records its opening source and quantity without activity transactions
recognized old demo stock uses the original template rather than remaining quantity
unrecognized seed-like records are not assigned a fabricated opening balance
